description.value: A well-equipped private campground right in Ucluelet on the west coast of Vancouver Island, with 125 sites ranging from waterfront harbour-view spots to semi-private forested sites, open year-round. Flush washrooms, showers, laundry, and a playground are on site; expect a busy commercial atmosphere with heavy RV presence alongside tent campers.

address.value: 260 Seaplane Base Road, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and fully corroborates OSM contact data (name, address, phone, postal code V0R 3A0). Amenities confirmed directly from website text: heated outdoor showers (new washroom building), guest laundry room, water stations at sites, a staff-managed storage shed for wildlife attractants (animal-safe food storage), mandatory online reservations, and propane tanks for sale (Instagram snippet on homepage). Power supply is confirmed by both OSM (power_supply=yes) and website (30 Amp RV hookups), but electrical service appears tied to RV sites rather than tent sites, so device charging for cyclists is left null absent explicit evidence of a communal charging point.
concerns: Campground Rules page is titled 'Campground Rules for 2020' — content may not have been updated since, though the business is clearly active (copyright 2026, ongoing Instagram posts).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, year-round campground with confirmed showers, laundry, potable water, animal-safe storage, and reservations at the gateway to Ucluelet; a clear benefit to touring cyclists on the west coast of Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: heated outdoor showers (new washroom building), guest laundry room, water stations at sites
